# Ehud Ettun

> Ehud Ettun is an Israeli-born, Boston-based double bassist, composer and educator. His contemporary jazz blends the jazz tradition with classical music and traditional Jewish and Israeli music. He leads the Ehud Ettun Trio and co-leads The Yabuno Ettun Project (piano-bass duo with Japanese pianist Haruka Yabuno). Booking, sideman work and lessons: ehudettun@gmail.com.

## Key facts
- Israeli-born, based in the Boston area; graduate of New England Conservatory.
- Performed at the Blue Note (New York) and the Kennedy Center (Washington, D.C.); toured with stops in Boston, Toronto, Berlin, Warsaw, Tokyo and Seoul.
- As a sideman, performed and recorded with Kenny Werner, Anat Cohen and George Garzone.
- Teaches jazz at NEC Prep (New England Conservatory); private double bass lessons in person near Boston and online worldwide.
- Founder and artistic director of Internal Compass Music, a music college and jazz hub in Mitzpe Ramon, Israel.
- Press: "Ettun can conjure the deep soulfulness of Charlie Haden." — The Boston Globe

## Ensembles
- Ehud Ettun Trio — originals and arrangements of standards and world/Israeli songs.
- The Yabuno Ettun Project — piano-bass duo, 15 years together.
- Internal Compass Collective — international ensemble.

## Discography
- Knights of Silence — The Yabuno Ettun Project (2024)
- Deep in the Mountains — Ehud Ettun (2019)
- Collage of Moments — Yabuno / Jancuric / Ettun (2016)
- Raw Gestures — Ehud Ettun Trio (2014)
- BiPolar — The Yabuno Ettun Project (2014)
- Heading North — Ehud Ettun (2012)
